simple.meaning: יְהוֹשַׁבְעַת (Yᵉhôwshabʻath) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a daughter in the family line and in connection with kingship and in connection with priesthood.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in 2 Chronicles, beginning at 2 Chronicles 22:11. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, kingship, priesthood.

simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows יְהוֹשַׁבְעַת through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

firstOccurrence.englishText: But Jehoshabeath, the king’s daughter, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stealthily rescued him from among the king’s sons who were slain, and put him and his nurse in the bedroom. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest (for she was the sister of Ahaziah), hid him from Athaliah, so that she didn’t kill him.
